attributes.title: Level 5

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using the scroller and status bar extensions!

questions.hint: The scroller extension can be used to scroll a background horizontally, vertically or both depending on the camera movement.
questions.title: [Select one] The scroller extension can only create horizontally scrolling backgrounds.
questions.correctResponse: The scroller extension can be used to scroll a background horizontally, vertically or both depending on the camera movement.

questions.hint: What customizations does the Status Bar extension allow?
questions.title: [Select all that apply]The status bar extension can:

answers.text: Show how many lives the player has left.

questions.correctResponse: Status bars can be customized to show different kinds of information such as Magic, Health, EnemyHealth and more!

questions.hint: What kind of information might a status bar show?
questions.title: How might you increase or decrease the value of a status bar in your project? (Sprite interactions, conditions, etc.)
questions.correctResponse: Those sound great, can’t wait to see what you create!

subgroups.title: Scrolling Background and Status Bar Extensions
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using the scroller and status bar extensions!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Green Belt! Before you create your final Green Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Extension Explorer
badges.description: Use the scroller and status bar MakeCode extensions to enhance a project.

badges.title: One Direction
badges.description: Set a project’s background to scroll horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

badges.title: Sticky Tack
badges.description: Prevent a project’s background image from moving unexpectedly.

badges.title: Setting the Bar
badges.description: Create and customize a status bar to be used in a project.

badges.title: Status Symbol
badges.description: Connect a status bar to a specific sprite in a project.
